entities.name: Manuel Arce y Ochotorena
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuel Arce y Ochotorena was a Spanish Cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church who served as Archbishop of Tarragona from 1944 until his death, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1946 by Pope Pius XII.
